content.comment_body: Hello, is there a way to synchronize the time for 8 [product_name] units without using the GSM module? For instance, could they be connected to a PC and have the time set via RJ45 cable (TCP/IP)?

You can synchronize the time via Internet using an NTP time server or through your router. For example, my router serves as a time server for my [product_name] with [version_no]. However, not all [product_name] devices with [article_no] support NTP time synchronization, only specific versions such as FS4 models.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for ways to synchronize time on multiple [product_name] devices without relying on the GSM module, preferring solutions using a PC or network connection. They are aware of options like NTP and router-based synchronization, but compatibility issues exist as only certain device versions support these methods.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to synchronize the time of all [product_name] units directly from a PC via LAN, without requiring a GSM module.
